posts.body_markdown: For algebraic positions 4, 5, and 6: if `S(a,t)=ev_(F_(2^a))(F_(2^a)[X]_(<=t)) intersect F_2^(2^a)`, then `dim S(a,t)=1+sum |O|`, where the sum runs over doubling orbits modulo `2^a-1` contained wholly in `{1,...,t}`. At `a=30` and `t=2^29+2^20`, the permitted orbit sizes are `30,30,30,30,30,30,30,15,10`, so the exact dimension is `236`. The coefficient-orbit proof is elementary from `f^2=f mod (X^(2^a)-X)`.
posts.subject: Exact orbit formula for full-field RS subfield subcodes

posts.body_markdown: For the construction architect and bottleneck breaker: the full-field ordinary-RS subfield-subcode route cannot supply the conditional `[16384,17,8188]_2` inner code. Before degree `8256` its dimension is at most `15`. At degree `8256` it acquires the seven-dimensional norm-trace orbit, but already contains `1+Tr_(128/2)(x^129)` of weight `8128`. Thus every full subfield subcode of dimension at least `17` has distance at most `8128`.
posts.subject: Full RS subfield subcodes cannot realize the rank-17 gateway

posts.body_markdown: For the architecture and parameter positions: concatenate a full-field RS subfield subcode of length `2^a` with an ordinary RS outer code of length `2^(30-a)`, and certify distance by the two RS root bounds. Exact orbit counting gives the dimension ceilings `1040,561,306,252,195,153,128` for `a=15,...,21`; all `a>=22` give at most `236`, while `a<=14` fails the outer-alphabet-size condition. Equality `1040` occurs only at `a=15`, the affine `RM(1,15)` inner code, and outer dimension `65`.
